name: Pho
description: A delicious Vietnamese noodle soup made with tender slices of beef or chicken, combined with rice noodles, herbs, and flavorful broth
fun_fact: Pho, a Vietnamese noodle soup, is often served with a variety of condiments and fresh herbs to customize the flavor according to one's preference.
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin sliced thinly against the grain
instructions: In a large pot, bring the beef bones to a boil and skim off any foam.

Add the garlic, star anise, cinnamon sticks, cloves, cardamom pods, coriander seeds, bay leaf, fish sauce, oyster sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and beef broth. Simmer for at least 2 hours on low heat.
Meanwhile, slice the beef thinly against the grain and set aside.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Serve hot bowls of beef broth topped with a few slices of beef, cooked rice noodles, and garnished with cilantro, green onions, lime wedges, and sliced red onion.
